# OET with Dr Hesham

> Online OET (Occupational English Test) preparation for doctors, nurses, pharmacists, physiotherapists, dentists and other allied health professionals, led by Dr Ahmed Hesham, a medical doctor and OET educator coaching OET candidates since 2018. Recorded courses, personally assessed Writing letters, private Speaking sessions and timed website practice for Paper-Based and Computer-Based OET, in English with Arabic support.

Key facts:
- Provider: OET with Dr Hesham (https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/), an online OET coaching service; learner app: https://app.oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/.
- Founder and lead teacher: Dr Ahmed Hesham (https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/about.html), a medical doctor and OET educator, coaching since 2018 (7+ years).
- Professions with dedicated courses: Medicine, Nursing, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Modified Allied Health (Modified Allied Health covers the other OET professions, including Dentistry).
- Full OET Course tiers, same price for Paper-Based and Computer-Based: Full OET Course + Website Practice £140; Complete OET Bundle + TutorBook £165 (Recommended); Ultimate OET Course £220.
- Full Crash Course tiers: Full Crash Essential £75; Full Crash + 5 Personal Writing Assessments £100; Full Crash + 5 Personal Assessments + TutorBook £125.
- Classic recorded courses: Classic Full Course + SAMI - Medicine £105 (also Pharmacy, Physiotherapy and Modified Allied Health); Classic Nursing OET Course £65; Nursing Premium Bundle £105.
- Writing letters are assessed personally by Dr Ahmed Hesham; private Speaking sessions are with an expert tutor; SAMI 24/7 is the included study assistant. Prices are in GBP and confirmed at checkout: https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/pricing.html.
- Results: 1,750 OET score cards shared by students are published at https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/success-stories.html.
- Languages: English and Arabic (Arabic pages under https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/ar/).
- Contact: support@oetwithdrhesham.co.uk, WhatsApp +44 7961 725989, https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/contact.html.
- Full text of every guide: https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/llms-full.txt. Blog feed: https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/feed.xml.

## OET courses and services

- [OET Course for Doctors Online | OET Medicine with Dr Hesham](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-course-for-doctors.html): Online OET Medicine course for doctors: 40+ hours of recorded lessons, letter correction and 1:1 Speaking practice for GMC and ECFMG score targets.
- [OET Course for Nurses Online | NMC-Ready Prep with Dr Hesham](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-course-for-nurses.html): Online OET course for nurses: 30+ hours of recorded nursing lessons, personalised letter correction and 1:1 Speaking practice to reach the NMC score.
- [OET Course for Pharmacists | OET Pharmacy Online, Dr Hesham](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-course-for-pharmacists.html): Online OET course for pharmacists: 25+ hours of recorded pharmacy lessons, pharmacy letters and Speaking cards, plus add-on letter correction for the GPhC.
- [OET Course for Physiotherapists Online](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-course-for-physiotherapists.html): Online OET course for physiotherapists: 40+ hours of recorded lessons, 5 letter assessments and 1:1 Speaking for HCPC, Ahpra and VisaScreen targets.
- [OET Course for Dentists | OET Dentistry, Dr Hesham](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-course-for-dentists.html): OET course for dentists: OET Dentistry Writing and Speaking, English rules for Australia, Ireland, New Zealand and the UK GDC, and a dental study plan.
- [OET for Allied Health Professionals | Course and Scores](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-for-allied-health.html): OET for allied health professionals: HCPC and Ahpra scores for OTs, radiographers, dietitians, podiatrists and speech therapists, plus a 40+ hour course.
- [OET Writing Correction Service | Letters Marked by Dr Hesham](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-correction.html): OET writing correction for nurses, doctors and pharmacists: letters marked with an estimated score, detailed corrections and WhatsApp voice-note feedback.
- [OET Speaking Practice Online: 1:1 Sessions](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-speaking-practice-online.html): OET Speaking practice online: private 1:1 sessions with detailed feedback, live virtual-patient role-plays, recorded courses and how to prepare for each one.
- [OET Mock Test Online: Full Timed Mock Exams](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-mock-test.html): Full OET mock tests online: all four sub-tests under real timing, Writing and Speaking feedback, auto-marked Listening and Reading, and when to sit each mock.

## OET Writing guides

- [OET Writing: Referral Letter Structure](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-referral-letter-structure.html): How to structure an OET Writing referral letter and choose which case notes to keep or omit, with a worked practice case, paragraph plan and model sentences.
- [OET Nursing Discharge Letter: The Final Request](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-nursing-discharge-letter.html): How to write an OET nursing discharge letter and its final request paragraph, with an invented case, note selection, a model letter and 5 closing sentences.
- [OET Physiotherapy Writing: Referral vs Discharge](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-physiotherapy-referral-vs-discharge.html): How OET physiotherapy referral and discharge letters differ in reader, purpose and emphasis, with one practice patient written up as both letter types.
- [OET Writing Tips 2026: 11 Letter Strategies](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-tips.html): OET Writing tips for nurses and doctors: letter type, reader, case-note selection, structure, tone and the final check before time.
- [OET Writing Sample for Nurses: Model Discharge Letter](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-sample-nursing.html): Free OET writing sample for nurses: realistic discharge case notes, a model letter to the district nurse and a criterion-by-criterion explanation.
- [OET Nursing Referral Letter Sample With Model Answer](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-sample-nursing-referral.html): Free OET nursing referral letter sample: practice nurse case notes, a model referral to a diabetes specialist nurse and marking notes.
- [OET Nursing Transfer Letter Sample: Hospital to Care Home](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-sample-nursing-transfer.html): Free OET nursing transfer letter sample: post-stroke case notes, a model letter to a care home nurse and a criterion-by-criterion explanation.
- [OET Writing Sample for Doctors: Model Referral Letter](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-sample-medicine.html): Free OET writing sample for doctors: GP case notes, a model referral letter to a cardiologist and an explanation of every selection decision.
- [OET Medicine Discharge Letter Sample With Model Answer](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-sample-medicine-discharge.html): Free OET medicine discharge letter sample: pneumonia case notes, a model discharge letter from hospital to the GP and an explanation of each decision.
- [OET Writing Sample for Pharmacists: Model GP Letter](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-sample-pharmacy.html): Free OET writing sample for pharmacists: medication review case notes, a model letter to a GP and an explanation of every selection decision.
- [OET Writing Sample for Physiotherapists: Discharge Letter](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-sample-physiotherapy.html): Free OET writing sample for physiotherapists: knee replacement case notes, a model letter to a community physiotherapist and marking notes.
- [OET Writing Sample for Occupational Therapy: Model Letter](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-sample-occupational-therapy.html): Free OET writing sample for occupational therapists: home assessment case notes after a fall, a model referral letter and marking notes.
- [OET Writing Samples: Model Letters by Profession](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-writing-samples.html): Free OET Writing samples with model answers for doctors, nurses, pharmacists, physios and occupational therapists: referral, discharge and transfer letters.

## OET Speaking guides

- [OET Speaking Empathy and Signposting](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-speaking-empathy-signposting.html): Show empathy that sounds genuine and signpost clearly in OET Speaking role-plays, mapped to the clinical communication criteria, with a worked practice example.
- [OET Speaking: Handling Angry or Anxious Patients](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-speaking-angry-anxious-patient.html): How to handle an angry, upset or anxious patient or relative in OET Speaking, mapped to the clinical communication criteria, with an invented card and dialogue.
- [OET Speaking Tips 2026: 11 Role-Play Strategies](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-speaking-tips.html): OET Speaking tips for nurses and doctors: patient-friendly language, empathy, structure, signposting and time control in role-plays.
- [OET Speaking Role-Play Cards for Nurses With Model Answers](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-speaking-role-play-nursing.html): Free OET Speaking role-play cards for nurses: two practice cards, a model role-play with marking notes, useful phrases and common mistakes.
- [OET Speaking Role-Play Cards for Doctors With Model Answers](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-speaking-role-play-medicine.html): Free OET Speaking role-play cards for doctors: two practice cards, a model consultation with marking notes, useful phrases and common mistakes.
- [OET Speaking Role-Plays for Pharmacists: Model Answers](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-speaking-role-play-pharmacy.html): Free OET Speaking role-play cards for pharmacists: two practice cards, a model role-play with marking notes, useful phrases and common mistakes.
- [OET Speaking Role-Plays for Physiotherapists: Model Answers](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-speaking-role-play-physiotherapy.html): Free OET Speaking role-play cards for physiotherapists: two practice cards, a model role-play with marking notes, useful phrases and common mistakes.
- [OET Speaking Role-Play Cards With Model Answers](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-speaking-role-play-cards.html): OET Speaking role-play cards for doctors, nurses, pharmacists and physiotherapists, with model answers, plus how the two role-plays are timed and marked.

## OET Reading guides

- [OET Reading Part B: Workplace Texts and Purpose](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-reading-part-b-workplace-texts.html): How to answer OET Reading Part B: six workplace texts, timing within Parts B and C, a purpose-first method and an invented practice text with worked answers.
- [OET Reading Part A: Scanning Under Time Pressure](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-reading-part-a-scanning.html): A 15-minute plan for OET Reading Part A: skim four texts, answer matching first, scan for anchor words and copy answers exactly, with a worked practice set.
- [OET Reading Part C: Inference and Distractors](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-reading-part-c-inference.html): How to answer OET Reading Part C inference questions: predict before the options, test each choice against the text and see why each distractor fails.
- [OET Reading Tips 2026: 10 Expert Strategies](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-reading-tips.html): OET Reading tips for healthcare professionals: Part A scanning, Part B and C distractors, inference and a weekly mock strategy.

## OET Listening guides

- [OET Listening Parts B and C: Method and Traps](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-listening-parts-b-c.html): OET Listening Parts B and C explained: format, question types, prediction from the options, opinion versus fact, distractors and a worked practice transcript.
- [OET Listening Part A: Note-Taking and Spelling](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-listening-part-a-note-taking.html): OET Listening Part A: predict each gap in 30 seconds, write the exact words you hear, handle spelling and abbreviations, with a worked consultation example.
- [OET Listening Tips 2026: 10 Expert Strategies](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-listening-tips.html): OET Listening tips for nurses and doctors: Part A, B and C strategies, note-taking, accents and distractors, from Dr Ahmed Hesham.

## Exam format, fees and comparisons

- [OET on Computer vs Paper: How to Prepare](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-computer-vs-paper.html): OET on paper, on computer or at home? See what changes in Writing, Reading and Speaking, how to choose a mode, and a two-week practice plan for each format.
- [OET Study Plan: 4, 8 and 12-Week Schedules](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-study-plan.html): Free OET study plans for 4, 8 and 12 weeks by sub-test: weekly hours, when to take the placement test and full mocks, and how to use free practice resources.
- [OET vs PTE for Healthcare Professionals](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-vs-pte.html): OET vs PTE Academic for doctors, nurses and dentists: format, timing, scoring, and which regulators accept each test, checked on official pages.
- [Retaking OET After a Near Miss: What to Change](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-retake-after-near-miss.html): Missed your OET target by one sub-test or a few points? How to read the result, regulator rules on combining sittings, re-marks, re-sits and when to rebook.
- [OET vs IELTS 2026 for Nurses and Doctors: Which Is Easier?](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-vs-ielts.html): Many nurses and doctors find OET easier because every task is clinical. OET grade B (350-390) compares with IELTS 7.0. Compare format, regulators and cost.
- [OET Test Dates 2027 & 2026, Fees and Results](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-test-dates-and-fees.html): OET test dates for 2027 (computer, January to June) and 2026, booking deadlines and results dates, plus the AU$587 fee, re-sit and rescheduling costs.
- [What Is the OET Exam? Format, Scoring and Cost](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/what-is-oet.html): OET is the Occupational English Test for healthcare professionals: 12 professions, four sub-tests, scored out of 500. See its format, cost and who accepts it.
- [OET Exam Fees 2026: Cost in the UK, India, Pakistan & More](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-exam-fees.html): The OET exam costs AU$587, about £302 in the UK. See the approximate cost by country, the US$455 USA price, and re-sit, re-mark and rescheduling fees.
- [OET Cancellation and Refund Policy Explained](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-cancellation-refund-policy.html): Cancelling your OET booking? OET keeps AU$120 before the booking closing date and AU$200 after it. Deadlines by test mode, no-shows, refunds and rescheduling.
- [OET Passing Score 2026: Grades, 350/500 and 30/42 Explained](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-passing-score.html): Grade B (350 out of 500) is the usual OET pass, typically about 30 out of 42 in Listening and Reading. Nurses often need only 300 in Writing. Grades and rules.

## Registration pathways and score requirements

- [OET Score Requirements 2026: NMC, GMC, Ahpra, NMBI & More](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-score-requirements.html): OET score requirements for 2026: minimum scores, sittings, OET@Home rules and validity for the NMC, GMC, Ahpra, NMBI, New Zealand, ECFMG and more.
- [OET for UK Registration 2026: NMC, GMC, GPhC and HCPC Guide](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/uk-pathway-guide.html): UK registration guide for OET candidates: NMC, GMC, GPhC and HCPC scores, steps, documents and common mistakes for 2026.
- [OET for the USA 2026: ECFMG, VisaScreen and State Boards](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/usa-pathway-guide.html): Does the USA accept OET? ECFMG for doctors, VisaScreen for nurses, TOEFL or IELTS for others: the English test, exams and state board steps by profession.
- [OET for ECFMG 2027: Required Scores and How to Send Results](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/oet-for-ecfmg.html): ECFMG needs OET Medicine: 350 in Listening, Reading and Speaking, 300 in Writing, one sitting. How to send results through MyIntealth, plus 2027 Match deadlines.
- [OET for Australia 2026: Ahpra Scores and Registration Guide](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/australia-pathway-guide.html): Australia pathway guide for OET doctors, nurses, pharmacists and physiotherapists covering AHPRA, AMC, NMBA, APC, APEP, English scores and OET preparation.
- [Gulf Pathway Guide 2026: OET for Qatar and Gulf Licensing](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/gulf-pathway-guide.html): OET for Gulf licensing: Qatar DHP verification and qualifying exam steps, UAE PQR and Saudi SCFHS rules, for doctors, nurses, pharmacists and physiotherapists.

- [سعر امتحان OET 2026 في مصر والسعودية والخليج](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/ar/oet-exam-fees.html): سعر امتحان OET الكامل 587 دولاراً أسترالياً، أي حوالي 21,730 جنيهاً مصرياً أو 1,510 ريالاً سعودياً. التكلفة حسب الدولة ورسوم الإعادة والتأجيل.
- [درجة النجاح في امتحان OET: 350 من 500 و30 من 42](https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/ar/oet-passing-score.html): درجة النجاح المعتادة في OET هي B أي 350 من 500، وعادةً 30 من 42 في الاستماع والقراءة. جدول الدرجات والحد الأدنى للأطباء والممرضين حسب كل جهة.
